To provide the reader with a comparison of the HEDS operation to modern HVAC equipment compliant with existing codes and design guidelines, we have conducted analysis to estimate the performance of an alternate baseline system that follows the guidelines specified in ASHRAE 90.1-2013 section 6.5.2. This provides a second comparison in addition to providing the measured results from the CAV baseline and VAV baseline operating modes, which were selected to represent typically installed and operated legacy HVAC systems. The following section describes the methodology and results for the alternate baseline evaluations. 2.2.4 Creation of Alternate Baseline Metrics 1. CAV alternate baseline metrics The baseline CAV mode used in this evaluation was selected to represent the operation of many legacy systems that apply VAV reheat following dehumidification. Based on ASHRAE 90.1- 2013 section 6.5.2, the current baseline for CAV mode (3) does not comply with zone control requirements. To allow a comparison of the measured performance of the HEDS with CAV operation that meets current standards, we generated an alternate baseline data set from the existing data to match 90.1 requirements, as follows: • A maximum flow rate of 50% of the rated zone supply flowrate is allowed when simultaneous heating and cooling take place (i.e. VAV reheat following cooling) as required for dehumidification and relative humidity control. • The supply air temperature should reset at minimum 25% difference between design supply and zone temperature setpoints to adjust to changing conditions like outdoor temperature or building load. Note that in several applications, including hospitals, laboratories and many manufacturing sites, constant airflow is required. The ASHRAE 90.1 standard allows exceptions for cases where application specific requirements dictate different operating conditions than the standard specifies, so the alternate baseline case will not be relevant to such applications. 23 This report is available at no cost from NREL at www.nrel.gov/publications. For the alternate baseline cases, the heating and cooling calls are determined based on the value of Space_load. The originally calculated values of Space_load and Misc_load are used for the alternate baseline calculations, but Fan_Power, HEDS_water_side_load, and VAV_reheat_load are recalculated.
